_doc: Rewarded ads v1 (Design/26). daily_cap: shared daily cap on rewarded ads, UTC day (Ads Break not counted). Each placement: reward = reward type (boost | income_seconds | gems | driver_coupon | gear_coupon; offline_double | race_bonus | daily_double are for tests only and v1 does not declare them; daily_gift_x2 = watch before claiming the daily login gift, doubles its gems, Design/30 §6); daily_limit 0 = only the shared cap applies; cooldown_sec between two claims; unlock = feature id in tutorial.json (empty = always open). Numbers are starting values and must be rebalanced after soft launch (Design/26 §5).

break._doc: Ads Break (interstitial between two races). Key names follow Horus SDK's monetize.interDue. Read by game/ads_break.gd.
